result.notes:
Changes made:
- requires_unknown_facts set to false. The ordinance covers ordinary residential rental property; the deed-restricted and similar carve-outs are exemptions and are listed in unverifiable_exemptions.
- supersedes_state_rule set to null. None of the provided documents mention Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.2, and the state-law reference was removed from the summary.
- min_building_age_years set to null. The rolling 15-year carve-out is already captured in new_construction_exemption, so keeping both would double-count it.
- The 15-year item was moved out of unverifiable_exemptions because it is expressed in new_construction_exemption.
- other_conditions reworded to match the source ('After 30 days') rather than 'more than 30 days'.
- 'Hotel and transient occupancy' and 'other shared living quarters' were added to unverifiable_exemptions. Hospital/care facilities and dormitories were left out on the assumption that assessor land-use codes can usually identify them.
- The record used to date 'housing produced' is not stated in the documents.
